optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: User Research Operations Specialist, Credit Workflow System
professionalSummary: Owned and managed the research operations programme for the credit workflow product for two years, serving as the designated programme owner and holding compliance sign‑off on all research plans.
Recruited underwriters and relationship managers from bank staff, maintaining comprehensive participant and consent records in the research repository.
Led quarterly research planning sessions with product design, documenting decisions and calendar in planning notes.
Coordinated research logistics with compliance and business units, clearly delineating responsibility boundaries for scheduling, consent and plan sign‑off.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate’s evidence supports all role requirements; human review recommended to confirm fit.

role.roleTitle: User Research Operations Specialist, Credit Workflow System

evidence.text: Owned the research operations programme for the credit workflow product for two years as the named programme owner, holding the compliance sign‑off on each research plan under the delegation recorded with the compliance office.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of ownership and compliance sign‑off.

evidence.text: Work sample: the compliance delegation record naming the candidate for research‑plan sign‑off, one signed research plan and the planning notes for one quarter, with the research repository's record identifiers as a verification trail.
Recruited underwriters and relationship managers as participants through the business units and maintained the participant and consent records in the research repository.
Led the quarterly research planning session with the product design team, deciding the research calendar and recording the decisions in the planning notes.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of session leadership and documentation.

evidence.text: Coordinated research logistics with compliance and the business units, recording that the business units owned participant availability while I owned scheduling, consent and the plan sign‑off.
Responsibilities included programme ownership, plan sign‑off, participant recruitment, consent records and the quarterly planning session over about two years.
evidence.notes: Implied documentation of limitations and hand‑over but not explicit.

missingEvidence: Explicit statement or sample showing documentation of known limitations and hand‑over conditions for each research round.
